documented_probe: C-1f4f846b (run the target application with the derived secret): exercised at the reference floor (hard). The verifier refuses the reward unless the side-effect file /app/releases/commit.token exists and byte-matches a fresh run of the shipped signer with the derived credential, so abstaining from running the app (no output file) fails.
notes: Two dependent stages: (1) reverse-engineer the v2 key-tape container (big-endian record framing, three pad encodings: raw / bit-complement / ascii-hex, per-shard pad selectors, and a reassembly manifest that differs from file order; the shipped v1 reader and spec are deliberately stale references), then (2) actually run /app/signer.py with the recovered credential so it emits the side-effect file. Hidden cases replay the generic decoder against fresh tapes (different pads, encodings, shard orders, credentials) and re-run the app with the derived secret. Nonzero rubric for dependent_stages, reasoning_depth (multi-record binary parsing + stale-doc reconciliation), hidden_case_generalization, quantitative_correctness (byte-exact token), and interaction_statefulness (side-effect must come from a real app run).
